batting.name: MA Agarwal

balls.text: low full toss at leg stump, clubbed along the floor to long-on

oh superb work from Pooran at sweeper cover! Slower ball, short and turning away outside off. Backs away and cuts aerially. Pooran tracks it to his left, keeps his eyes on it, and dives with the perfect timing to grab it before tumbling softly in his landing to keep it
low full toss at middle stump, drilled firmly along the floor to long-on

drops short of deep midwicket. Low full toss at middle stump, looks for the slog but can't get that away. It plops into the turf in front of Allen. Rahul not happy that he's allowed Pollard to come back for the strike
yorker outside off, looks to smoke it through the covers, gets it to long-on off the thick inside edge. Pollard was running before Shami had even released the ball
nails the yorker at off stump, clears the front leg and looks to force this straight, but it rolls down to long-off
dipping, tailing yorker at leg stump. Quickly jams it to deep midwicket's right
full and just outside off, tails away late. Looks to drill that through extra and gets a thick outside edge straight to short third
full and just outside off, might have been a slower ball. Hardik lines it up and looks to loft this over long-off. Difficult on this surface. Picks out Hooda
yorker, very wide outside off. Left alone
full toss outside off, nice height to slap it through cover, but he goes too hard and misses on this
low full toss wide outside off, steps out and gets it to short third off the toe-end

a two-handed forehand over long-off! Sheer power that. It's a slower ball, short and wide outside off. Not easy to just muscle that, let alone over the straight boundary. But those rules do no apply to Pollard
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Chopped to backward point with soft hands
low full toss at middle stump, shuffles and punches to long-on
cutter at a length outside off, gets forward and stabs at that. Thick outside edge drops short of Rahul

whipped straight to deep square. Low full toss at middle stump, gets low and whips this flat. There was a decent gap between deep square and fine leg, but he can't find it. A good knock from Rohit after the early struggles, but Punjab have stated this death overs phase very nicely. A sharp catch from Allen too, high to his right
just past off stump. Rohit misses out on an overpitched delivery. Full and in the corridor, ends up making too much room as he looks to drill that over extra cover
attempted dipping yorker outside off, met on the full and driven to long-on
length on middle stump, defended on the front foot
googly at a length on leg stump, whipped to deep backward square

through everyone! Pollard doesn't pick this googly. Rahul is annoyed with himself, but that was so close to the middle stump. Short of a length and coming in from off stump, Pollard whips in panic and is completely beaten
slider at a length on middle stump, punched to midwicket off the back foot
full at middle stump, leans in to stab to long-on
taken at short third! Legbreak, full and outside off. SKY switches up and looks to swing this reverse sweep over backward point. Gets a top edge and it hands up nicely for Gayle
full outside off, gets low and sweeps to fine leg
full slower ball outside off, dragged to deep square with a laboured slog
yorker outside off, gets down for the sweep and gets an inside edge towards fine leg. Lbw appeal turned down

beaten on the sweep. Shami thinks there's an edge on that. Rahul unsure about whether that's carried. It's been reviewed. Looks like an umpire's reviews, not DRS. So the umpire thinks there's an edge on it. Slower ball at a length outside off, gets low and looks to get it to whip that square and misses as that gets big on him. But that's landed in front of Rahul as he lunges forward
beats long-on to the right. Overpitched at middle stump, walks into the off side and picks this up off his toes. Whips to Pooran's right and he can't get a hand to it after sprinting
full slower ball outside off, looks to drive through cover, gets it off the inside half through midwicket
short of a length at middle stump, pushed to deep midwicket off the back foot
slapped to long-off's left. Short and turning away outside off, stretches his arms and goes through with this horizontal bat shot. Looks it came off the low part of the bat, but it is in the gap
short of a length outside off, cut to deep extra's left
short of a length just outside off, punched to sweeper off the back foot
full at off stump, driven off the toe-end to deep extra
short of a length outside off, punched to deep extra cover off the back foot
full on leg stump, leans in and flicks to deep midwicket
googly sliding on at leg stump from a good length, whipped to deep square
walks across and scoops this to deep backward square's right. Length and into middle stump, gets low early and deliberately goes aerial
length outside off, driven on the rise to long-off
oh nicely placed to get his fifty. Legbreak ripping away from length wide outside off, reaches out and slashes it fine of backward point off the front foot
legbreak at a length outside off, gets low and reverse-paddles to short third
offcutter, short of a length outside off. Steps out and stabs it to extra cover's right
offcutter gets big and cramps him at off stump. Kicks up from a length and he steers to point
offcutter at a length, down leg side
yorker at leg stump from around the wicket, flicked with the angle to fine leg
swept to fine leg's. Length on middle stump, an offcutter. Gets low and sweeps on the bounce to Bishnoi's left
goes inside-out over extra cover! Treats him like he would a left-arm spinner, and just as well. It's a cutter at middle stump, he humps down the track and goes with the turn. Trademark stuff
offcutter at a length on off stump, looks to drive and gets a thick outside edge as that one grips
offbreak at a length outside off, looks for the slog sweep and gets an inside edge onto pad
length outside off, gets forward and flicks to short fine
length and turning in at off stump, gets low and jabs to backward point with an open face

pulled over deep midwicket! That's two bad balls from spin now against Rohit and he's taken them for 12. Looks to slam this into the pitch, but it's too short. Turns into his swinging arc at middle stump and it disappears
short of a length, turning in and cramping him at middle stump. Jabbed into the off side off the back foot
short of a length and turning into middle stump, waits on it and punches to deep point's right
offcutter cramps him at the stumps again, a length ball that he tries to jab in front of point
offcutter, short of a length and getting steep at off stump. Defended to point
length ball, offcutter outside off. Punched on the up to long-off's left
steered past short third. Good length and slanted into off stump. Opens the face and chops it
cutter at a length on off stump, gets big on him as he shapes to punch on the rise. Can't get it past cover
length on leg stump, shuffles and clips to deep square leg
length outside off, drives on the rise to sweeper cover
pumped over wide long-on! Allen pulls out the towel immediately to wipe his hands. A friendly full toss, at middle stump. Stands tall and slams that across the line
length and dipping outside of, leans in and jabs it to point
full at off stump, driven to long-off with the turn
full outside off, driven through extra cover off the front foot
full and just outside off, inside-out drive, aerially to sweeper's right
tossed up full outside off, mistimed drive trickles to extra cover
googly, short of a length and in at off stump. Chopped to backward point's left
full outside off, gets low to sweep along the floor to deep backward square
full outside off, swept straight to short fine
googly, sliding in from a length at leg stump. Looks to whip to deep midwicket off the back foot and gets an inside edge onto thigh
aerial but safely to point's right. Length ball jumps up outside off, checks his attempted square drive and it runs to sweeper's left
length at middle, deep in the crease to punch to long-on
length on off stump, driven to long-off with the turn
full on middle stump, flicked to long-on with the angle
length at the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
steered past backward point again. Full and wide outside off, gets low and opens the face, uses his wrists, and beats the dive to the left once again
past backward point whose dive is a little late. It's a length ball outside off, pushed through quick. Reaches out and opens the face to steer that

caught behind! Doesn't even wait for the umpire's decision. Kishan's horror form continues. This is a short of a length slider across off stump. He looks to cut and gets a thin edge, Rahul holds on well. Bishnoi strikes in his first over of the season
full at leg stump, driven to long-on
full and just outside off, nice stride forward to drive to sweeper's right
full and just outside off, drilled firmly to long-off
length and skidding on at leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket's right
short of a length legbreak outside off, steers it straight to Gayle at slip, on the bounce
short of a length at leg stump, looks to glance that behind short fine and can't connect
cutter at a length on middle stump, punched on the up to long-on
short of a length in the corridor, looks to punch through the off side, gets an inside edge onto body
offcutter at a length on off stump, dropped in front of Allen with soft hands and he makes him scramble again
length at middle and off, punched to cover on the up
length and into middle stump, opens the face and runs this to point's left
first boundary of the innings. Low full toss outside off, gets low and sweeps him past short fine
length outside off, driven to extra cover's right
offcutter at a length on off stump, punched to mid-off on the up
offcutter at a length outside off, feels for that outside off. It skids on and gets the inside edge as he pokes on the front foot
offcutter skids in with the angle, at a length at middle stump. Whipped straight to midwicket
cutter at a length outside off, pushed to point off the back foot
full and just outside off, hurried drive off the toe-end to long-off
good length at off stump, defended on the front foot
full and faster at leg stump, flicked to square leg's right
length at off stump, defended into the covers
good length at middle stump, turning away and bouncing to get the outside edge as he defends with soft hands
full on leg stump, leans in and flicks through midwicket
full and just outside off, driven on the front foot to mid-off
good length and just outside off, steered to point's left off the front foot
good length and just outside off, punched to extra cover's right
good length, possibly an offcutter, at middle stump. Blocked on the front foot
floaty full toss at middle stump, punched to long-on
big appeal for catch behind from Rahul and he's the only one. Full outswinger outside off, looks for the big cover drive and jams the bat into the pitch after he's beaten

dragged straight to mid-on! Length ball outside off, steps out and wants to slap it on the rise over that fielder. It sticks in the pitch and comes off the inside half and floats gently out to Henriques
full on leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket
short of a length at leg stump, tickled to short fine
full and just outside off, punched aerially to mid-off's left
length on middle stump, punched down the pitch off the back foot
short of a length at leg stump, leaves that and it hits him on the thigh
short of a length at middle and leg, nudged to deep square off the back foot

he's given caught down leg side and has reviewed it. Short of a length and rising up at his hips as he looks to tickle that fine. There's a sound on it. On first replay it looks like that sound is from impact with his hip. And Ultra Edge confirms it
length and outside off, punched to sweeper on the up
full at middle stump, driven to mid-on off the front foot

good length and swung away from middle stump, opens the face and drops it into the off side and is surprised as Allen has a throw at the non-strikers end! He was out if that had hit. Rohit was too casual there
good length and swung in from outside off, chopped off the front foot to sweeper
caresses it fine of third man to seal the win! Yorker ball just outside off, stays inside the line and uses his wrists to open the face by a lot and runs this past the fielder
crunched over long-on! Full toss at full face, just outside off. Behind the line of that and clears the fielder with ease
full and into leg stump, squeezes it to deep square's left

pumped over deep midwicket! Boult goes regular pace short ball, and Gayle is just praying for something like that after biding his time on this wicket. Sits up nicely at off stump and pulled viciously
length and just outside off, jabbed into the covers off the back foot

oh smart batting. Walks a long way into the off side and gets a short-arm pull to fine leg's right. It's a short of a length ball ripping away again. Chahar does brilliantly with a sprint and slide. Looks to whip it back but caught in an awkward position, ends up getting it into the boundary padding due to his momentum
kicks up and into Gayle's left arm. Short of a length at middle stump and turning square, past his outside edge
top edge lands safely at square leg and he brings up fifty with that. Short of a length slower ball at middle stump, wants to close the face and shovel that fine but he closes the face too soon
length ball, cutter outside off. Poked to point's left and he takes on Hardik to steal the single
a fast offbreak at length, rips past his bat as he looks to push into the off side

just short of long-on. A low full toss, pushed through quick at middle stump. Miscues his attempted slog. Krunal appeals for the run-out here. Gayle plonked the bat down as he took the bails off. But he was safe
slow, length, very wide outside off. Left alone
quicker, flatter, and very wide outside off. Left alone

pushed into the boundary padding. Length ball outside off, swings with the turn to deep square's right. Bumrah puts in a slide and tries to parry this to deep midwicket, but can't get enough strength on his flick
length ball very wide outside off, turns in, but still called a wide as Gayle lets this go
full at off stump, driven to long-off's left
short of a length and skidding through, not a lot of turn, as he gets back and looks to cut. Beaten
spins square again after pitching leg stump. He looked to close the face and push that into the leg side, catches it on the back thigh

turns too much and misses off stump! Rahul was batting outside leg stump, reaching in for the drive as this landed on middle stump. Didn't get to the pitch and that turned a long long way. They send it up for the stumping too but the foot was grounded
beaten again. Length and turning away rapidly as Gayle gets forward to block
beaten. Shuffles into the off side and Yadav pushes it quicker and shorter. Doesn't even thing of the slog as this rips away
short of a length and turning away outside off, mistimed pull to square leg
beaten. Length ball, slower and wide outside off. Looks for the slog sweep and that spins a lot
swung into the top-tier! Gets one in the slot at long last and he doesn't waste it. Length and pushed through flat at middle stump. Slides in nicely and he pummels this over long-on
length in the corridor, patted on the back foot
just short of the bowler. Cutter, short of a length and rising outside off. Looks to punch towards long-on but that gets big and awkward on him and dips on the bowler
short of a length cutter outside off, punched to sweeper's left and calls early and confidently for the second
pick-up short clears fine leg. It's length and it's down leg side. Rahul brings out the trademark short-arm whip without attempting to keep that down
short of a length just outside off, under-edge on the attempted cut
slower ball, short and wide outside off. Cut to sweeper's right
short and just outside off, under-edge on the attempted cut
full at middle stump, looks to drill that straight. Gets a thick inside edge and Kishan misfields at square leg
length outside off, shuffles and stabs that to point
heaved wide of long-on. Length outside off, uses his reach to get to it and gets a subdued slog between deep midwicket and long-on

takes a risk and it pays off. Yadav nearly had him. This was length and fired in at middle stump from around middle stump. He steps a long way into the off side, leg stump visible, and this keeps low. But he gets bat on that and swipes to the long leg boundary
length at leg stump, punched to long-on
short of a length and sliding on outside off, allows that to come on and dabs it fine of short third. Chahar chases and puts in a slide to pull that back
short at middle stump, pulled firmly to deep midwicket
short of a length and cramping him at middle stump. Hurriedly jammed through midwicket off the back foot
short of a length and down leg side, opens up the leg side with a move into the off and pats this on its head, into the fine leg boundary
beaten on the slog. Short of a length and ripping in from outside off, just past the off stump too
shapes for the slog sweep but that's a wrong'un or a topspinner and he adjusts to chop this into the off side
short of a length and turning away from middle stump, shuffles and glances to deep square
length and just outside off, blocked on the front foot
length and straightening outside off, that was pushed through quick. Defended hurriedly into the off side
length and just outside off, punched to sweeper's left
short of a length just outside off, late cut straight to short third
beaten on the cut. Short of a length and skidding on in the corridor, exposes the stumps as he looks to cut
short of a length and turning into off stump, hurriedly punched to the bowler's left
short of a length at off stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
full outside off, leans in and pushes into vacant midwicket
short and rising legbreak outside off, punched to sweeper cover
Hardik hauls it in to his right at deep midwicket. Length at middle stump, miscued slog sweep bounce to his right and opens up his palm and drags this in
full at middle stump, pushed down the wicket
length at off stump, gets forward and jabs this through the covers
short of a length and turning away outside off, defended into the pitch with soft hands
length outside off, left alone
length at off stump, defended on the front foot
length at middle stump, blocked on the front foot with the turn
length and turning into leg stump, whipped to deep square
length and turning into off stump, pushed back to the bowler off the back foot
length at middle stump, punched back to the bowler off the back foot
googly outside off, leans in and pushes it back to the bowler
full outside off, drives to long-off
length ball outside off, punched towards extra cover off the back foot

half-hearted loft finds long-on. Full delivery at leg stump, hurries into this attempted lofted drive over long-on, but he's not committed fully into it. Comes off the inside half and SKY takes it running forward and to his right. Mayank shadow practices a sweep as he walks off
legbreak turning away from a length on middle stump, gets forward and pushes through cover
spun past the outside edge. Good length and rising and turning outside off as he looks for the square drive on the rise
length at middle stump, whipped to deep midwicket off the back foot
short of a length and sliding into off stump, punched to point off the front foot
length and into leg stump, tickled to short fine's right off the inside edge
short and down leg side, gets low, still on the front foot, but swipes this firmly past short fine
length and into leg stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
length at off stump, defended to backward point from the crease

offcutter at a length outside off, gets forward and pushes to backward point. Kishan throws the ball at the striker's end, hits it, and luckily for him it goes through to midwicket backing up. I can see Jaywardene mouth "Ishan, what are you doing?" in the dugout. Rohit has his face in his palm, QDK has words for Ishan too
full at leg stump, pushed straight to mid-on off the front foot
stabbed past short third. Short and outside off, hangs deep in the crease, uses the pace and times it perfectly
full toss outside off, mistimed punch to sweeper's right
offcutter, short of a length outside off. Shuffles and dabs into the off side
good length outside off, legbreak delivered with a googly release. Late on the forward push, gets it into the leg side off the inside half
length at middle stump, gets low and sweeps this time, out to deep midwicket
rips past the outside edge. Length, pitching middle and drawing him forward, before beating him comprehensively as he looks to drive through the off side
can't hold on to a difficult chance. Short of a length at off stump, sticking and turning. Looks to punch to long-off. Chahar flies to his left with two hands but can't get there
short of a length outside off, legbreak, cut straight to cover
shapes to pull and leaves as this spins square. Rising furiously away outside off after pitching middle and leg
offcutter at a length outside off, opens the face and can't beat short third
slower ball at a length on leg stump, jabbed to midwicket off the back foot
full and just outside off, driven to sweeper cover with a nice stride forward
low full toss outside off, clears the front leg and drills straight to sweeper cover
high full toss outside off. An attempted slower ball gone wrong. Mayank arches back and ramps that past short third. Now he has a free hit too

misfield at backward point. Short of a length and tight in the corridor. Quick hands on the back foot punch. Flies to Kishan and bursts through his hands as he looks to field. Might have touched his face too before trickling into the boundary
short of a length outside off, waits leg side of that and steers to short third
slower short on at leg stump, hauled out to fine leg with the pull

helps it over fine leg. Short and tucking him up at the hips, but he swivels on the back foot, and uses the pace and the angle and some great wrists to lift this short-arm pull. No intention to keep it down. Punjab have more than Mumbai's powerplay total already
short of short third. Short of a length ball gets dip on him as he looks for the late cut. It was an offcutter
offcutter at a length, cutting into off stump. Defended on the front foot
length at middle stump, pushed into the leg side with the angle
short of a length and into the pads, glanced to fine leg's left

oh that is glorious! Unreal to pull that off on this pitch. Length ball dips at off stump. He isn't to the pitch of this, but he gets so low and the pace is so slow off this pitch that he can leverage the rising ball after creating room - whips through it and gets it over extra cover. Expert stuff
length at middle stump, defended to short extra
length on off stump, gets forward and drops it into the off side with soft hands
dropped short and punished again! This one isn't a quicker one, but it is very short. Sticks in the surface, turns away from off, but he's waited before pulling over midwicket
dropped short and in the corridor, slides on nicely and he waits before cutting it past point
full at middle and leg, driven with the turn to extra cover
short of a length and just outside off, opens the face and runs it to short third
short of a length and curved into the corridor. Looks for the cut and gets it off the under-edge again
short of a length outside off, shapes to cut and gets that off the under-edge to the keeper

fumble at midwicket and they lose out on a run-out chance. SKY can't get it on the first attempt. Rahul has a sheepish look, there wasn't a run there. Full and into middle stump, pushed with soft hands to SKY's right
good length and swung in at off stump, punched to mid-off on the rise
full inswinger outsider, leans in nicely for the cover drive but Kishan flings himself to the left to stop at short extra
